findings.result: The same existing one-use Material Source host is consumed. It retains the original session/operation/custody Arcs and absolute end; export spends material_source_taken before postchecks. The peer may not be the registered daemon. The unchanged f42d9 owner-channel helper rejects same UID/PID, checks actual boot/start identity, actual SO_PEERCRED and original pidfd before/after construction. Root and Material use the same pre-held authenticated stream in reverse once for ready; no descriptor clone, substitute witness, reconnect, new Root grant or second Source lane is added.

The frozen first layer immediately asked for completed Source on its first request. If A was not yet published, original Missing/Pending refused and the client channel slot was consumed. The first layer alone therefore was not a ready-before-first-read implementation. That historical limitation is retained; the independent ready successor addresses scheduling without rewriting the first packet.

The only new notification caller is the fixed original Task service, after handle(Publish), original source binding and current Root checks succeed. The unchanged Publish handler first reads the original Cell execution, obtains real reverse completion, publishes through original Source, re-reads Cell and Source and checks the returned decision. The observer then separately re-reads same operation and same Task/Cell/Source before marking the private hint. It does not treat an argv flag, digest or hint as proof of completion. Publication or other original side effects can precede a later observer/send error; that remains uncertainty, not rollback.

Before waiting, the host performs one actual source observation under exact task context. A completed source is immediately fully checked against the original Cell/current and does not wait for a future notification. Only the original Source read error ReconciliationRequired takes the waiting branch. The inspected original journal maps Missing and Pending to that error; corrupt/conflict and uncertain storage errors remain distinct refusals. The private same-task latch performs one condvar wait with the remaining common absolute startup deadline. Spurious/late wakes reject; no Source/Cell/Current/issuer/lease lock is retained over the condvar wait and no polling or retry loop is introduced. After waking, a full current read is mandatory again.

The fixed HCPRERDY frame is exactly binding+nonce+id1 in the original 64-byte request shape. Root sends it through the same HAP request path; Material acknowledges only exact bytes through the same HAP exchange. The frame carries no Source result or execution authority. Both sides then start Source data at id2 and end at id128, so the whole Source loan has 128 frames and at most 127 data reads. Initial reads, Experience intake reads and later Material reads share that same counter; no per-stage reset or additional 128 allowance exists. The unrelated original four Material command permits are untouched.

A data read first verifies identity/run then takes the sole channel out of its Mutex<Option>. It checks the fixed enrollment/end, advances the same counter, makes the original bounded request, verifies exact request-prefix response, decodes only after that authenticated exchange, compares the complete configured source and actual original record, checks actual peer lifetime/current enrollment and the deadline, and only then restores the channel. Any error after take leaves it empty. Clone of the private source branch shares this same Arc; the public prefreeze client has no Clone, raw-source getter or owner getter. The original raw decoder is only widened to pub(super) for this sibling and its body is unchanged. The local Source and previous RootMaterial branches retain their original code.

Root uses actual custody, requires the same generation operation/intent and exact configured Source/task digest, reads the actual Source publication and same-Arc Cell through the original helper, encodes the complete original request/saved input/result under the actual owner, re-reads and compares the same publication, and rechecks operation/current. The material decoder creates data only, not a Driver receipt, Source writer or ledger authority. The original 16KiB whole-response limit remains, including the request prefix.

The non-Clone client retains the original Arc<Mutex<LedgerWriter>>. Before and after public reads/intake it checks exact ledger binding, distribution/generation and the original evidence. append_original_experience_v2 delegates unchanged to the original signed Generator/independent Observer intake with original partial-append behavior. Transition consumes this client, reads the current publication, binds it to Material initial request, exact trust and both original signer/owner identities, rechecks the original ledger, and passes the very same Source, identity and ledger to the old into_command_owner. The original factory retains freeze/signature/ledger/Recovered-vs-Fresh/four-permit checks; no re-sign or fresh authority is fabricated.
